payload.name: Extract Expressed Aesthetic Preferences
payload.description: When a speaker explicitly says they find a place, scene, or sensory aspect beautiful, gorgeous, or otherwise appealing, during extraction.
content: During extraction, if a speaker explicitly expresses admiration or preference for a visual or sensory aspect of a place, experience, or object (e.g., 'the colors are so beautiful', 'the view is amazing'), create a durable preference memory recording the speaker as subject and the appreciated aspect as object.

Capture the aspect in the speaker's own words and resolve relative time from the message timestamp; do not require a standalone opinion sentence - the statement may occur within a suggestion, plan, or small talk.
Stop after the stated aspect; do not infer additional likes or extend the same admiration to unmentioned features.

solves: Construction agents sometimes skip explicit statements of admiration or preference when they appear inside suggestions, plans, or small talk, leaving no memory to answer later questions about what a person likes or finds beautiful.
